'use client'

/**
 * TalentBridge_V2 — Job Board view (all roles).
 * Seekers see profile-aligned roles pinned first with a gradient hairline +
 * match badge + progress bar, can apply (and withdraw) with an optional cover
 * letter; recruiters can post, delete their own jobs and view applicants;
 * company gets a read-only board. Polls every 8s like the rest of the app.
 */
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import {
  Briefcase,
  Building2,
  Check,
  Loader2,
  MapPin,
  Plus,
  Send,
  Sparkles,
  Trash2,
  Undo2,
  Users,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/components/ui/avatar'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { api } from '@/lib/api-client'
import type { JobDTO, JobType, SafeUser } from '@/lib/types'
import { useAuthGuard, useAuthErrorEffect } from './auth-context'
import { ApplicantsDialog } from './applicants-dialog'
import { ApplyDialog } from './apply-dialog'
import { PostJobDialog } from './post-job-dialog'
import { initials, roleTheme, timeAgo, toastError, toastSuccess, type Accent } from './tb-utils'
import { EASE, MotionCard, SectionHeading } from './tb-motion'

interface Props {
  user: SafeUser
  accent: Accent
  /** Jump to a 1:1 conversation (used by the recruiter's applicants dialog). */
  onOpenConversation?: (conversationId: string) => void
}

/* ------- Literal class maps (Tailwind needs literals, keyed by accent) ------- */

/** Accent-tinted chip / badge base. */
const ACCENT_CHIP: Record<Accent, string> = {
  blue: 'border-blue-400/30 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-300',
  emerald: 'border-emerald-400/30 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300',
  violet: 'border-violet-400/30 bg-violet-500/10 text-violet-300',
}

/** High-preference badge — accent tint + subtle glow. */
const HIGH_BADGE: Record<Accent, string> = {
  blue: 'border-blue-400/30 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-300 shadow-[0_0_14px_-6px] shadow-blue-500/60',
  emerald:
    'border-emerald-400/30 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300 shadow-[0_0_14px_-6px] shadow-emerald-500/60',
  violet:
    'border-violet-400/30 bg-violet-500/10 text-violet-300 shadow-[0_0_14px_-6px] shadow-violet-500/60',
}

/** Gradient hairline border wrapper stops (like the login card). */
const HIGH_WRAPPER: Record<Accent, string> = {
  blue: 'from-blue-400/40 via-white/10 to-white/5',
  emerald: 'from-emerald-400/40 via-white/10 to-white/5',
  violet: 'from-violet-400/40 via-white/10 to-white/5',
}

/** Job type badge — muted glass, with tinted exceptions. */
const TYPE_BADGE: Record<JobType, string> = {
  'Full-time': 'border-white/10 bg-white/[0.05] text-muted-foreground',
  'Part-time': 'border-sky-400/25 bg-sky-500/15 text-sky-300',
  Internship: 'border-amber-400/25 bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-300',
  Contract: 'border-rose-400/25 bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-300',
}

/** Badge copy for high-preference cards. */
function highBadgeLabel(job: JobDTO): string {
  if (job.match.score >= 60) return `Strong match · ${job.match.score}%`
  if (job.match.matchedSkills.length > 0) {
    return `High preference · ${job.match.matchedSkills.length} skill${job.match.matchedSkills.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
  }
  return 'Role aligned with your profile'
}

/* --------------------------------- Card ---------------------------------- */

interface JobCardProps {
  job: JobDTO
  accent: Accent
  canDelete: boolean
  isConfirming: boolean
  deletePending: boolean
  onDeleteClick: (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void
  /** Seeker can apply to this job. */
  canApply: boolean
  /** Recruiter owns this job and can view its applicants. */
  canViewApplicants: boolean
  applyPending: boolean
  withdrawPending: boolean
  onApply: () => void
  onWithdraw: () => void
  onViewApplicants: () => void
}

function JobCard({
  job,
  accent,
  canDelete,
  isConfirming,
  deletePending,
  onDeleteClick,
  canApply,
  canViewApplicants,
  applyPending,
  withdrawPending,
  onApply,
  onWithdraw,
  onViewApplicants,
}: JobCardProps) {
  const theme = roleTheme[accent]
  const isHigh = job.match.high
  const matchedKeys = new Set(job.match.matchedSkills.map((s) => s.toLowerCase()))

  const card = (
    <MotionCard
      accent={accent}
      className={cn('flex h-full flex-col gap-3 p-4', isHigh && 'rounded-2xl')}
    >
      {isHigh && (
        <>
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <Badge
              variant="outline"
              className={cn('gap-1.5 border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold', HIGH_BADGE[accent])}
            >
              <Sparkles className="size-3" aria-hidden />
              {highBadgeLabel(job)}
            </Badge>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
              <span>Profile match</span>
              <span className={cn('tabular-nums', theme.text)}>{job.match.score}%</span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1 h-0.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/8">
              <div
                className={cn('h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r', theme.gradient)}
                style={{ width: `${Math.max(job.match.score, 8)}%` }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {/* Title + type */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <h3 className="min-w-0 truncate text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground" title={job.title}>
          {job.title}
        </h3>
        <Badge variant="outline" className={cn('shrink-0 border text-[10px]', TYPE_BADGE[job.type])}>
          {job.type}
        </Badge>
      </div>

      {/* Company + location */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1">
          <Building2 className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
          <span className="truncate">{job.company}</span>
        </span>
        <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1">
          <MapPin className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
          <span className="truncate">{job.location}</span>
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Description */}
      <p className="line-clamp-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{job.description}</p>

      {/* Skills — matched skills highlighted with a check */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
        {job.skills.map((skill) => {
          const matched = matchedKeys.has(skill.toLowerCase())
          return (
            <span
              key={skill}
              className={cn(
                'flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px]',
                matched ? ACCENT_CHIP[accent] : 'border-white/8 bg-white/[0.04] text-foreground/70',
              )}
            >
              {matched && <Check className="size-3" aria-hidden />}
              {skill}
            </span>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Action row — seeker applies / recruiter views applicants */}
      {(canApply || canViewApplicants) && (
        <div className="mt-1">
          {canApply && (
            job.applied ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span
                  className={cn(
                    'flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold',
                    'border-blue-400/30 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-300',
                  )}
                >
                  <Check className="size-3.5" aria-hidden /> Applied
                </span>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  className="h-8 shrink-0 gap-1 px-2.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-300 active:scale-95"
                  disabled={withdrawPending}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation()
                    onWithdraw()
                  }}
                >
                  {withdrawPending ? (
                    <Loader2 className="size-3 animate-spin" aria-hidden />
                  ) : (
                    <Undo2 className="size-3" aria-hidden />
                  )}
                  Withdraw
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Button
                type="button"
                className={cn('w-full gap-2 shine active:scale-[0.98]', theme.solid)}
                disabled={applyPending}
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation()
                  onApply()
                }}
              >
                <span className="relative z-10 flex items-center gap-2">
                  {applyPending ? (
                    <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden />
                  ) : (
                    <Send className="size-4" aria-hidden />
                  )}
                  Apply
                </span>
              </Button>
            )
          )}
          {canViewApplicants && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              className="w-full gap-2 border-white/10 bg-white/[0.04] text-foreground hover:border-white/20 hover:bg-white/[0.08] active:scale-[0.98]"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation()
                onViewApplicants()
              }}
            >
              <Users className="size-4" aria-hidden />
              {job.applicantCount} Applicant{job.applicantCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Footer */}
      <div className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-2.5 border-t border-white/8 pt-3">
        <span className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br p-[2px]', theme.avatarRing)}>
          <Avatar className="size-7">
            <AvatarFallback className="rounded-full bg-[oklch(0.19_0.022_275)] text-[10px] font-bold text-white">
              {initials(job.postedByName)}
            </AvatarFallback>
          </Avatar>
        </span>
        <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs">
          <span className="text-foreground">Posted by {job.postedByName}</span>
          <span className="text-muted-foreground"> · {timeAgo(job.createdAt)}</span>
        </p>
        {canDelete && (
          <>
            {isConfirming && (
              <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-medium text-red-300">Click again</span>
            )}
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="icon"
              className="size-7 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-300 active:scale-90"
              aria-label={
                isConfirming ? 'Click again to confirm delete' : `Delete job: ${job.title}`
              }
              disabled={deletePending}
              onClick={onDeleteClick}
            >
              <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
            </Button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </MotionCard>
  )

  if (!isHigh) return card
  return (
    <div className={cn('h-full rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b p-px', HIGH_WRAPPER[accent])}>
      {card}
    </div>
  )
}

/* --------------------------------- View ---------------------------------- */

export function JobsView({ user, accent, onOpenConversation }: Props) {
  const guard = useAuthGuard()
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const theme = roleTheme[accent]

  const [postOpen, setPostOpen] = useState(false)
  const [confirmId, setConfirmId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [applyJob, setApplyJob] = useState<JobDTO | null>(null)
  const [applicantsJob, setApplicantsJob] = useState<JobDTO | null>(null)

  const jobsQuery = useQuery({ queryKey: ['jobs'], queryFn: api.getJobs, refetchInterval: 8000 })
  useAuthErrorEffect(jobsQuery.error)

  const jobs = jobsQuery.data?.jobs ?? []
  const isSeeker = user.role === 'job_seeker'
  const isRecruiter = user.role === 'recruiter'

  const highJobs = isSeeker ? jobs.filter((j) => j.match.high) : []
  const highCount = highJobs.length
  const total = jobs.length

  /** Up to 6 unique matched skills across high-preference jobs (strip preview). */
  const stripSkills: string[] = []
  if (highCount > 0) {
    const seen = new Set<string>()
    for (const j of highJobs) {
      for (const s of j.match.matchedSkills) {
        const key = s.toLowerCase()
        if (seen.has(key)) continue
        seen.add(key)
        stripSkills.push(s)
        if (stripSkills.length === 6) break
      }
      if (stripSkills.length === 6) break
    }
  }

  const deleteJob = useMutation({
    mutationFn: api.deleteJob,
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['jobs'] })
      setConfirmId(null)
      toastSuccess('Job removed', 'The posting is no longer visible on any job board')
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      guard(err)
      toastError(err.message)
    },
  })

  const withdraw = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (jobId: string) => api.withdrawApplication(jobId),
    onSuccess: (_data, jobId) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['jobs'] })
      const job = jobs.find((j) => j.id === jobId)
      toastSuccess('Application withdrawn', job ? `You withdrew from "${job.title}"` : undefined)
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      guard(err)
      toastError(err.message)
    },
  })

  function handleDeleteClick(jobId: string, event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) {
    // Keep the card-level "clear confirm" handler from firing.
    event.stopPropagation()
    if (confirmId !== jobId) {
      setConfirmId(jobId)
      return
    }
    deleteJob.mutate(jobId)
  }

  const description = isRecruiter
    ? 'Post a role, then track every candidate who applies.'
    : user.role === 'company'
      ? 'Read-only view of every posting published by recruiters.'
      : highCount > 0
        ? `${highCount} of ${total} roles align with your profile — they're pinned to the top.`
        : 'No openings align with your profile yet — check back soon.'

  return (
    <section aria-label="Job Board" className="space-y-5">
      <SectionHeading
        accent={accent}
        eyebrow="Job Board"
        title={
          <>
            Open <span className={theme.gradientText}>roles</span>
          </>
        }
        description={description}
        right={
          isRecruiter ? (
            <Button
              onClick={() => setPostOpen(true)}
              className={cn('h-10 gap-2 px-4 text-sm font-semibold shine active:scale-[0.98]', theme.solid)}
            >
              <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden /> Post a Job
            </Button>
          ) : undefined
        }
      />

      {/* Seeker alignment strip */}
      {isSeeker && highCount > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-white/8 bg-white/[0.03] p-3 backdrop-blur-xl">
          <span
            className={cn(
              'flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br text-white shadow-lg',
              theme.gradient,
              theme.glow,
            )}
          >
            <Sparkles className="size-4" aria-hidden />
          </span>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{highCount}</span> of {total} roles align
            with your profile
          </p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            {stripSkills.map((skill) => (
              <span
                key={skill}
                className={cn('rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs', ACCENT_CHIP[accent])}
              >
                {skill}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Cards */}
      {jobsQuery.isLoading ? (
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
            <Skeleton key={i} className="h-64 rounded-xl bg-white/5" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : jobs.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-white/8 bg-white/[0.03] px-6 py-16 text-center backdrop-blur-xl">
          <span className="flex size-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-white/8 bg-white/[0.04]">
            <Briefcase className="size-6 text-muted-foreground/60" aria-hidden />
          </span>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">No jobs posted yet</p>
          {isRecruiter && (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Post the first role to get started.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* NOTE: self-contained mount animation per card (NOT a parent-driven
           StaggerGroup) — jobs can appear mid-session (posted live or picked up
           by polling) and late-mounted children of an already-shown stagger
           parent would stay stuck at opacity 0. `layout` reflows the grid when
           a card is deleted. */
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          {jobs.map((job, index) => (
            <motion.div
              key={job.id}
              layout
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: EASE, delay: Math.min(index * 0.06, 0.36) }}
              className="h-full"
              onClick={() => setConfirmId(null)}
            >
              <JobCard
                job={job}
                accent={accent}
                canDelete={isRecruiter && job.postedById === user.id}
                isConfirming={confirmId === job.id}
                deletePending={deleteJob.isPending && deleteJob.variables === job.id}
                onDeleteClick={(event) => handleDeleteClick(job.id, event)}
                canApply={isSeeker}
                canViewApplicants={isRecruiter && job.postedById === user.id}
                applyPending={false}
                withdrawPending={withdraw.isPending && withdraw.variables === job.id}
                onApply={() => setApplyJob(job)}
                onWithdraw={() => withdraw.mutate(job.id)}
                onViewApplicants={() => setApplicantsJob(job)}
              />
            </motion.div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <PostJobDialog key={String(postOpen)} open={postOpen} onOpenChange={setPostOpen} />
      <ApplyDialog key={`apply-${applyJob?.id ?? 'none'}`} open={!!applyJob} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setApplyJob(null)} job={applyJob} />
      <ApplicantsDialog
        key={`apps-${applicantsJob?.id ?? 'none'}`}
        open={!!applicantsJob}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setApplicantsJob(null)}
        job={applicantsJob}
        onOpenConversation={onOpenConversation ?? (() => {})}
      />
    </section>
  )
}

]

const TONES = {
  seeker: 'from-blue-500 to-cyan-400',
  recruiter: 'from-emerald-500 to-teal-400',
  company: 'from-violet-500 to-fuchsia-400',
} as const

const CHIP_GLOW = {
  seeker: 'hover:shadow-[0_4px_24px_-8px] hover:shadow-blue-500/40',
  recruiter: 'hover:shadow-[0_4px_24px_-8px] hover:shadow-emerald-500/40',
  company: 'hover:shadow-[0_4px_24px_-8px] hover:shadow-violet-500/40',
} as const

function DemoGroup({
  label,
  accounts,
  tone,
  cols,
  pendingEmail,
  onPick,
}: {
  label: string
  accounts: DemoAccount[]
  tone: keyof typeof TONES
  cols: string
  pendingEmail: string | null
  onPick: (account: DemoAccount) => void
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-muted-foreground">
        {label}
      </p>
      <div className={cn('mt-2 grid gap-2', cols)}>
        {accounts.map((acc) => (
          <motion.button
            key={acc.email}
            type="button"
            disabled={pendingEmail !== null}
            onClick={() => onPick(acc)}
            whileTap={{ scale: 0.96 }}
            transition={spring}
            className={cn(
              'group relative flex items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-white/8 bg-white/[0.04] px-2.5 py-2 text-left backdrop-blur transition-all duration-200',
              'hover:border-white/20 hover:bg-white/[0.08]',
              CHIP_GLOW[tone],
              'disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50',
            )}
          >
            <span
              className={cn(
                'flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br text-[10px] font-bold text-white shadow-md transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:scale-105',
                TONES[tone],
              )}
            >
              {initials(acc.name)}
            </span>
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 leading-tight">
              <span className="block truncate text-xs font-medium text-foreground">{acc.name}</span>
              <span className="block truncate text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{acc.caption}</span>
            </span>
            {pendingEmail === acc.email && (
              <Loader2 className="size-3.5 shrink-0 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
            )}
          </motion.button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export function LoginPage() {
  const { login } = useAuth()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [pendingEmail, setPendingEmail] = useState<string | null>(null)

  async function doLogin(mail: string, pwd: string) {
    setError(null)
    try {
      await login(mail, pwd)
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Login failed'
      setError(message)
      toastError(message)
    }
  }

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (submitting) return
    setSubmitting(true)
    await doLogin(email, password)
    setSubmitting(false)
  }

  async function handleDemo(account: DemoAccount) {
    if (pendingEmail) return
    setPendingEmail(account.email)
    await doLogin(account.email, '123456')
    setPendingEmail(null)
  }

          <span className="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-white">
            TalentBridge<span className="align-super text-xs text-cyan-300">V2</span>
          </span>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div variants={fadeUp} className="max-w-lg space-y-6">
          <h1 className="text-5xl font-bold leading-[1.06] tracking-tight text-white">
            Bridging{' '}
            <span className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-400 to-cyan-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              talent
            </span>{' '}
            to{' '}
            <span className="bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-400 to-fuchsia-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              opportunity.

          </h1>
          <p className="max-w-md text-base leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">

'use client'

/**
 * TalentBridge_V2 — custom month calendar grid (no calendar library).
 * Dark luxury styling: gradient month title, glass nav buttons, directional
 * AnimatePresence slide, hairline cells, glow event pills.
 */
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion'
import {
  eachDayOfInterval,
  endOfMonth,
  endOfWeek,
  format,
  isSameDay,
  isSameMonth,
  isToday,
  parseISO,
  startOfMonth,
  startOfWeek,
} from 'date-fns'
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Flag } from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import type { EventDTO } from '@/lib/types'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { eventPill, roleTheme, type Accent } from './tb-utils'

interface Props {
  events: EventDTO[]
  accent: Accent
  onSelectEvent: (event: EventDTO) => void
  /** Events targeted at this user get a flag marker (e.g. the logged-in job seeker). */
  highlightUserId?: string
  /** Optional action rendered in the calendar header (e.g. recruiter "Create Event"). */
  headerAction?: React.ReactNode
}

const WEEKDAYS = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'] as const

export function MonthCalendar({ events, accent, onSelectEvent, highlightUserId, headerAction }: Props) {
  const [month, setMonth] = useState<Date>(new Date())
  const [dir, setDir] = useState(0)
  const theme = roleTheme[accent]

  const days = useMemo(
    () =>
      eachDayOfInterval({
        start: startOfWeek(startOfMonth(month)),
        end: endOfWeek(endOfMonth(month)),
      }),
    [month],
  )

  const byDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, EventDTO[]>()
    for (const e of events) {
      const list = map.get(e.date) ?? []
      list.push(e)
      map.set(e.date, list)
    }
    return map
  }, [events])

  function shift(delta: number) {
    setDir(delta)
    setMonth((m) => startOfMonth(new Date(m.getFullYear(), m.getMonth() + delta, 1)))
  }

  function goToday() {
    setDir(0)
    setMonth(new Date())
  }

  const navBtn =
    'border-white/10 bg-white/[0.04] text-muted-foreground transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-white/20 hover:bg-white/[0.08] hover:text-foreground active:translate-y-0 active:scale-95'

  return (
    <div className="glass overflow-hidden rounded-xl shadow-[0_18px_60px_-24px_oklch(0_0_0/60%)]">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-b border-white/8 px-4 py-3">
        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className={navBtn} aria-label="Previous month" onClick={() => shift(-1)}>
          <ChevronLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden />
        </Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className={navBtn} aria-label="Next month" onClick={() => shift(1)}>
          <ChevronRight className="size-4" aria-hidden />
        </Button>
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
          <motion.h2
            key={format(month, 'yyyy-MM')}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: dir === 0 ? 0 : dir * 8 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: dir === 0 ? 0 : -dir * 8 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: 'easeOut' }}
            className={cn('min-w-36 text-center text-base font-semibold tracking-tight', theme.gradientText)}
          >
            {format(month, 'MMMM yyyy')}
          </motion.h2>
        </AnimatePresence>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className={cn('h-8 border-white/10 bg-white/[0.04] transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-white/[0.08]', theme.navActiveText)}
          onClick={goToday}
        >
          Today
        </Button>
        {headerAction && <div className="ml-auto">{headerAction}</div>}
      </div>

      {/* Grid (horizontally scrollable on very small screens) */}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto p-3">
        <div className="min-w-[640px]">
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
            <motion.div
              key={format(month, 'yyyy-MM')}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, x: dir === 0 ? 0 : dir * 48 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, x: dir === 0 ? 0 : -dir * 48 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: 'easeOut' }}
            >
              <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5 pb-1.5">
                {WEEKDAYS.map((d) => (
                  <div
                    key={d}
                    className="py-1 text-center text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-muted-foreground"
                  >
                    {d}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5">
                {days.map((day) => {
                  const key = format(day, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
                  const dayEvents = byDate.get(key) ?? []
                  const inMonth = isSameMonth(day, month)
                  const flagged = highlightUserId
                    ? dayEvents.some((e) => e.targetUserId === highlightUserId)
                    : false
                  const todayCell = isToday(day)
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={key}
                      className={cn(
                        'min-h-24 rounded-lg border border-white/[0.06] bg-white/[0.02] p-1.5 transition-colors duration-200 hover:border-white/12 hover:bg-white/[0.05] md:min-h-28',
                        !inMonth && 'opacity-30',
                        todayCell && theme.todayRing,
                      )}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-0.5">
                        <span
                          className={cn(
                            'flex size-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs font-semibold',
                            todayCell
                              ? theme.todayChip
                              : inMonth
                                ? 'text-foreground'
                                : 'text-muted-foreground/60',
                          )}
                        >
                          {format(day, 'd')}
                        </span>
                        {flagged && (
                          <Flag className="size-3 text-amber-400" aria-label="Your event" />
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-1 space-y-1">
                        {dayEvents.slice(0, 3).map((e) => (
                          <button
                            key={e.id}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onSelectEvent(e)}
                            className={cn(
                              'block w-full truncate rounded-md border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-left text-[10px] font-medium transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-[1.03] hover:brightness-110 active:scale-100',
                              eventPill(e.type, accent),
                            )}
                            title={`${e.title} · ${e.time}`}
                          >
                            {e.time} {e.title}
                          </button>
                        ))}
                        {dayEvents.length > 3 && (
                          <p className="px-1.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                            +{dayEvents.length - 3} more
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

/** Helper used by list views to format an EventDTO date. */
export function eventDateLabel(date: string): string {
  try {
    return format(parseISO(date), 'EEE, dd MMM yyyy')
  } catch {
    return date
  }
}

export { isSameDay }

/**

 * Polls /api/notifications every 3.5s; rows navigate to the DM or the event.
 * Dark glass-strong popover, ping dot on unread, staggered row entrance.
 */
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { Bell, CalendarDays, CheckCheck, Mail } from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'

interface Props {
  accent: Accent
  onOpenConversation: (conversationId: string) => void
  onOpenEvent: (eventId: string) => void
}

function NotificationRow({
  n,
  onClick,
}: {

}) {
  const isDm = n.type === 'dm'
  return (

      onClick={() => onClick(n)}
      className={cn(
        'group relative flex w-full items-start gap-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors duration-200',
        n.read ? 'bg-transparent hover:bg-white/[0.05]' : 'bg-white/[0.04] hover:bg-white/[0.08]',
      )}
    >
      {/* unread accent edge */}
      {!n.read && (
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className={cn(
            'absolute bottom-1.5 left-0 top-1.5 w-[3px] rounded-full bg-gradient-to-b',

          )}
        />
      )}
      <span
        className={cn(
          'mt-0.5 flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:scale-105',

            : 'border-emerald-400/25 bg-emerald-500/15',
        )}
      >

          className={cn(

          )}

      )}

export function NotificationBell({ accent, onOpenConversation, onOpenEvent }: Props) {
  const guard = useAuthGuard()
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [justMarked, setJustMarked] = useState(false)

  const { data } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['notifications'],
    queryFn: api.getNotifications,
    refetchInterval: 3500,
  })

  const markRead = useMutation({
    mutationFn: api.markNotificationsRead,
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['notifications'] })
      setJustMarked(true)
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      guard(err)
      if (!(err instanceof Error && err.message.includes('401'))) toastError(err.message)
    },
  })

  // Brief success tick after marking everything read.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!justMarked) return
    const t = setTimeout(() => setJustMarked(false), 1600)
    return () => clearTimeout(t)
  }, [justMarked])

  const notifications = data?.notifications ?? []
  const unread = data?.unreadCount ?? 0
  const dms = notifications.filter((n) => n.type === 'dm')
  const events = notifications.filter((n) => n.type === 'event')

  // Majority unread type decides the ping tone; a tie reads amber.
  const unreadDms = dms.filter((n) => !n.read).length
  const unreadEvents = events.filter((n) => !n.read).length
  const tone = unreadDms === unreadEvents ? 'amber' : unreadDms > unreadEvents ? 'blue' : 'emerald'

  function handleClick(n: NotificationDTO) {
    if (!n.read) markRead.mutate({ ids: [n.id] })
    if (n.type === 'dm') onOpenConversation(n.refId)
    else onOpenEvent(n.refId)
    setOpen(false)
  }

  return (
    <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="icon"
          className="relative text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-foreground active:scale-90"
          aria-label={`Notifications (${unread} unread)`}
        >
          <Bell className="size-5" aria-hidden />
          {unread > 0 && (
            <>
              <span
                aria-hidden
                className="animate-pulse-ring absolute -right-0.5 -top-0.5 size-4 rounded-full"
                style={{
                  ['--pulse-color' as string]:
                    tone === 'blue'
                      ? 'oklch(0.62 0.19 262 / 0.55)'
                      : tone === 'emerald'
                        ? 'oklch(0.7 0.15 162 / 0.55)'
                        : 'oklch(0.78 0.15 80 / 0.55)',
                }}
              />
              <span
                aria-hidden
                className={cn(
                  'absolute -right-0.5 -top-0.5 flex h-4 min-w-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r px-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-white',
                  tone === 'blue'
                    ? 'from-blue-500 to-cyan-400'
                    : tone === 'emerald'
                      ? 'from-emerald-500 to-teal-400'
                      : 'from-amber-500 to-orange-400',
                )}
              >
                {unread > 9 ? '9+' : unread}
              </span>
            </>
          )}
        </Button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent
        align="end"
        className="glass-strong w-80 rounded-xl border-white/10 p-0"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/8 px-4 py-3">
          <p className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-400 via-cyan-300 to-violet-300 bg-clip-text text-sm font-semibold text-transparent">
            Notifications
          </p>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            className={cn(
              'h-7 gap-1 px-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground underline-offset-2 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-foreground hover:underline',
              justMarked && 'text-emerald-300',
            )}
            disabled={markRead.isPending || unread === 0}
            onClick={() => markRead.mutate({ all: true })}
          >
            {justMarked ? (
              <>
                <CheckCheck className="size-3.5" aria-hidden /> All read
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <CheckCheck className="size-3.5" aria-hidden /> Mark all read
              </>
            )}
          </Button>
        </div>
        <div className="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto p-2">
          {notifications.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 py-10 text-center">
              <span className="flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-white/8 bg-white/[0.04]">
                <CheckCheck className="size-4 text-emerald-300" aria-hidden />
              </span>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">You&apos;re all caught up</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {dms.length > 0 && (
                <>
                  <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 pb-1 pt-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-muted-foreground">
                    <Mail className="size-3 text-blue-300" aria-hidden /> Messages
                  </p>
                  <motion.div
                    className="space-y-1"
                    variants={stagger}
                    initial="hidden"
                    animate="show"
                  >
                    {dms.map((n) => (
                      <NotificationRow key={n.id} n={n} onClick={handleClick} />
                    ))}
                  </motion.div>
                </>
              )}
              {events.length > 0 && (
                <>
                  <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 pb-1 pt-3 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-muted-foreground">
                    <CalendarDays className="size-3 text-emerald-300" aria-hidden /> Calendar
                  </p>
                  <motion.div
                    className="space-y-1"
                    variants={stagger}
                    initial="hidden"
                    animate="show"
                  >
                    {events.map((n) => (
                      <NotificationRow key={n.id} n={n} onClick={handleClick} />
                    ))}
                  </motion.div>
                </>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  )
}

'use client'

/**
 * TalentBridge_V2 — recruiter-only "Post a Job" dialog.
 * The parent remounts it via key={String(open)}, so form state is always
 * fresh on every open without any reset effects. Skills are parsed live
 * from a comma-separated input with an instant chip preview.
 */
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { Loader2, Plus } from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label'
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select'
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { api } from '@/lib/api-client'
import type { JobType } from '@/lib/types'
import { useAuthGuard } from './auth-context'
import { roleTheme, toastError, toastSuccess } from './tb-utils'

interface Props {
  open: boolean
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
}

const JOB_TYPES: JobType[] = ['Full-time', 'Part-time', 'Internship', 'Contract']

export function PostJobDialog({ open, onOpenChange }: Props) {
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="glass-strong rounded-2xl border-white/10 sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 tracking-tight">
            <span className="flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-500 to-teal-400 text-white shadow-md shadow-emerald-500/30">
              <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden />
            </span>
            Post a Job
          </DialogTitle>
          <span aria-hidden className="block h-0.5 w-12 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 to-teal-300" />
          <DialogDescription className="text-muted-foreground">
            Every candidate will see this on their Job Board instantly.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        {open && <PostJobForm onDone={() => onOpenChange(false)} />}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  )
}

function PostJobForm({ onDone }: { onDone: () => void }) {
  const guard = useAuthGuard()
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const theme = roleTheme.emerald

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('')
  const [company, setCompany] = useState('')
  const [location, setLocation] = useState('')
  const [type, setType] = useState<JobType>('Full-time')
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('')
  const [skillsInput, setSkillsInput] = useState('')

  /** Comma-separated input → trimmed, case-insensitively deduped skill list. */
  const parsedSkills = useMemo(() => {
    const seen = new Set<string>()
    const list: string[] = []
    for (const raw of skillsInput.split(',')) {
      const skill = raw.trim()
      const key = skill.toLowerCase()
      if (!skill || seen.has(key)) continue
      seen.add(key)
      list.push(skill)
    }
    return list
  }, [skillsInput])

  const createJob = useMutation({
    mutationFn: api.createJob,
    onSuccess: ({ job }) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['jobs'] })
      toastSuccess('Job posted', `"${job.title}" is now live on the job board`)
      onDone()
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      guard(err)
      toastError(err.message)
    },
  })

  function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (title.trim().length < 3) {
      toastError('Title must be at least 3 characters')
      return
    }
    if (company.trim().length < 2) {
      toastError('Company must be at least 2 characters')
      return
    }
    if (location.trim().length < 2) {
      toastError('Location must be at least 2 characters')
      return
    }
    if (description.trim().length < 2) {
      toastError('Description must be at least 2 characters')
      return
    }
    if (parsedSkills.length < 1) {
      toastError('Add at least one required skill')
      return
    }
    createJob.mutate({
      title: title.trim(),
      company: company.trim(),
      location: location.trim(),
      type,
      description: description.trim(),
      skills: parsedSkills,
    })
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="job-title" className="text-muted-foreground">Title *</Label>
        <Input
          id="job-title"
          placeholder="e.g. Senior Frontend Engineer"
          className="border-white/10 bg-white/[0.05] focus-visible:ring-emerald-400/40"
          value={title}
          onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
          maxLength={120}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="job-company" className="text-muted-foreground">Company *</Label>
          <Input
            id="job-company"
            placeholder="e.g. TalentBridge Labs"
            className="border-white/10 bg-white/[0.05] focus-visible:ring-emerald-400/40"
            value={company}
            onChange={(e) => setCompany(e.target.value)}
            maxLength={80}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="job-location" className="text-muted-foreground">Location *</Label>
          <Input
            id="job-location"
            placeholder="e.g. Remote · Bengaluru"
            className="border-white/10 bg-white/[0.05] focus-visible:ring-emerald-400/40"
            value={location}
            onChange={(e) => setLocation(e.target.value)}
            maxLength={80}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="job-type" className="text-muted-foreground">Type *</Label>
        <Select value={type} onValueChange={(v) => setType(v as JobType)}>
          <SelectTrigger id="job-type" className="w-full border-white/10 bg-white/[0.05]">
            <SelectValue placeholder="Select type" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent className="border-white/15 bg-[oklch(0.14_0.02_275/97%)] shadow-2xl shadow-black/50 backdrop-blur-xl">
            {JOB_TYPES.map((t) => (
              <SelectItem key={t} value={t}>
                {t}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <Label htmlFor="job-description" className="text-muted-foreground">Description *</Label>
          <span
            className={cn(
              'text-[10px] tabular-nums',
              description.trim().length > 0 && description.trim().length < 2
                ? 'text-amber-300'
                : description.length > 1900
                  ? 'text-amber-300'
                  : 'text-muted-foreground/70',
            )}
          >
            {description.length}/2000 · min 2
          </span>
        </div>
        <Textarea
          id="job-description"
          placeholder="What the role involves, expectations, benefits…"
          rows={4}
          className="border-white/10 bg-white/[0.05] focus-visible:ring-emerald-400/40"
          value={description}
          onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
          maxLength={2000}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="job-skills" className="text-muted-foreground">Skills *</Label>
        <Input
          id="job-skills"
          placeholder="React, TypeScript, Next.js"
          className="border-white/10 bg-white/[0.05] focus-visible:ring-emerald-400/40"
          value={skillsInput}
          onChange={(e) => setSkillsInput(e.target.value)}
          maxLength={300}
        />
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pt-0.5">
          {parsedSkills.length > 0 ? (
            <>
              {parsedSkills.map((skill) => (
                <span
                  key={skill}
                  className="rounded-full border border-emerald-400/30 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] text-emerald-300"
                >
                  {skill}
                </span>
              ))}
              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                {parsedSkills.length} skill{parsedSkills.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
              </span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
              Comma-separated, e.g. React, TypeScript, Next.js
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <DialogFooter>
        <Button
          type="submit"
          disabled={createJob.isPending}
          className={cn('w-full shine active:scale-[0.98]', theme.solid)}
        >
          <span className="relative z-10 flex items-center gap-2">
            {createJob.isPending ? (
              <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden />
            ) : (
              <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden />
            )}
            Post a Job
          </span>
        </Button>
      </DialogFooter>
    </form>
  )
}

'use client'

/**
 * TalentBridge_V2 — recruiter dashboard (EMERALD/TEAL identity).
 * Greeting + CountUp stats, applicant board of hover-lift cards, schedule
 * list with target chips. Message = glass CTA, Schedule = gradient + shine.
 */
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { format } from 'date-fns'
import {
  CalendarDays,
  CalendarPlus,
  Clock,
  Mail,
  Users,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/components/ui/avatar'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { api } from '@/lib/api-client'
import type { SafeUser } from '@/lib/types'
import { useAuthGuard, useAuthErrorEffect } from './auth-context'
import { CreateEventDialog } from './create-event-dialog'
import { eventPill, initials, roleTheme, statusBadge, todayISO, toastError } from './tb-utils'
import { CountUp, MotionCard, SectionHeading, StaggerGroup, StaggerItem } from './tb-motion'

interface Props {
  user: SafeUser
  onOpenConversation: (conversationId: string) => void
}

export function RecruiterDashboard({ user, onOpenConversation }: Props) {
  const guard = useAuthGuard()
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const [createFor, setCreateFor] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined)
  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false)
  const theme = roleTheme.emerald

  const seekersQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['users', 'job_seeker'],
    queryFn: () => api.getUsers('job_seeker'),
  })
  const eventsQuery = useQuery({ queryKey: ['events'], queryFn: api.getEvents })

  useAuthErrorEffect(seekersQuery.error)
  useAuthErrorEffect(eventsQuery.error)

  const openConversation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: api.openConversation,
    onSuccess: ({ conversation }) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['conversations'] })
      onOpenConversation(conversation.id)
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      guard(err)
      toastError(err.message)
    },
  })

  const today = todayISO()
  const upcoming = (eventsQuery.data?.events ?? [])
    .filter((e) => e.date >= today)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.date + a.time).localeCompare(b.date + b.time))
  const seekers = seekersQuery.data?.users ?? []

  const hour = new Date().getHours()
  const greeting = hour < 12 ? 'Good morning' : hour < 18 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening'
  const firstName = user.name.split(' ')[0]

  const thisMonth = (eventsQuery.data?.events ?? []).filter(
    (e) => e.date.slice(0, 7) === today.slice(0, 7),
  ).length

  const stats = [
    {
      label: 'Candidates',
      value: seekersQuery.isLoading ? 0 : seekers.length,
      icon: Users,
      hint: 'On your applicant board',
    },
    {
      label: 'Upcoming events',
      value: eventsQuery.isLoading ? 0 : upcoming.length,
      icon: CalendarDays,
      hint: 'Interviews & calls ahead',
    },
    {
      label: `Events in ${format(new Date(), 'MMMM')}`,
      value: eventsQuery.isLoading ? 0 : thisMonth,
      icon: Clock,
      hint: 'Scheduled this month',
    },
  ]

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <SectionHeading
        accent="emerald"
        eyebrow="Dashboard"
        title={
          <>
            {greeting}, <span className={theme.gradientText}>{firstName}</span>
          </>
        }
        description={format(new Date(), 'EEEE, d MMMM yyyy')}
      />

      {/* Stat tiles */}
      <StaggerGroup className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
        {stats.map((s) => (
          <StaggerItem key={s.label}>
            <MotionCard accent="emerald" className="flex items-center gap-3.5 p-4">
              <span
                className={cn(
                  'flex size-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-gradient-to-br shadow-lg',
                  theme.gradientSoft,
                  theme.text,
                )}
              >
                <s.icon className="size-5" aria-hidden />
              </span>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                  <CountUp value={s.value} />
                </p>
                <p className="truncate text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{s.label}</p>
              </div>
              <span
                aria-hidden
                className={cn('h-1 w-8 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r opacity-60', theme.gradient)}
              />
            </MotionCard>
          </StaggerItem>
        ))}
      </StaggerGroup>

      {/* Applicant board */}
      <div>
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-muted-foreground">
            Applicant board
          </p>
          <Users className={cn('size-4', theme.text)} aria-hidden />
        </div>
        {seekersQuery.isLoading ? (
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
            {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
              <Skeleton key={i} className="h-56 w-full rounded-xl bg-white/5" />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <StaggerGroup className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
            {seekers.map((s) => (
              <StaggerItem key={s.id}>
                <MotionCard accent="emerald" className="flex h-full flex-col">
                  <div className="flex-1 space-y-3 p-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <span className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br p-[2px]', theme.avatarRing)}>
                        <Avatar className="size-11">
                          <AvatarFallback className="rounded-full bg-[oklch(0.19_0.022_275)] text-sm font-bold text-white">
                            {initials(s.name)}
                          </AvatarFallback>
                        </Avatar>
                      </span>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">{s.name}</p>
                        <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.title ?? '—'}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {s.status && (
                      <Badge variant="outline" className={statusBadge[s.status] ?? ''}>
                        {s.status}
                      </Badge>
                    )}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                      {s.skills.slice(0, 3).map((skill) => (
                        <span
                          key={skill}
                          className="rounded-full border border-white/8 bg-white/[0.04] px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-foreground/70 transition-colors duration-200 hover:border-emerald-400/40 hover:text-emerald-300"
                        >
                          {skill}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                      {s.skills.length > 3 && (
                        <span className="rounded-full border border-white/8 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                          +{s.skills.length - 3}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex gap-2 border-t border-white/8 p-3">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      className="flex-1 gap-1.5 border-white/10 bg-white/[0.04] hover:border-white/20 hover:bg-white/[0.08] active:scale-[0.97]"
                      disabled={openConversation.isPending}
                      onClick={() => openConversation.mutate(s.id)}
                    >
                      <Mail className="size-3.5" aria-hidden /> Message
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      className={cn('shine flex-1 gap-1.5 active:scale-[0.97]', theme.solid)}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setCreateFor(s.id)
                        setCreateOpen(true)
                      }}
                    >
                      <span className="relative z-10 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <CalendarPlus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden /> Schedule
                      </span>
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </MotionCard>
              </StaggerItem>
            ))}
          </StaggerGroup>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Your schedule */}
      <MotionCard accent="emerald" className="p-5" delay={0.08}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-muted-foreground">
            Your schedule
          </p>
          <CalendarDays className={cn('size-4', theme.text)} aria-hidden />
        </div>
        <div className="mt-4">
          {eventsQuery.isLoading ? (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
                <Skeleton key={i} className="h-14 w-full rounded-lg bg-white/5" />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : upcoming.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 py-8 text-center">
              <span className="flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-white/8 bg-white/[0.04]">
                <CalendarDays className="size-4 text-muted-foreground/60" aria-hidden />
              </span>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No events yet</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="max-h-72 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {upcoming.slice(0, 4).map((e) => (
                <div
                  key={e.id}
                  className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-white/[0.06] bg-white/[0.02] p-2.5 transition-all duration-200 hover:translate-x-1 hover:border-white/12 hover:bg-white/[0.05]"
                >
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      'flex size-11 shrink-0 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-gradient-to-br',
                      theme.gradientSoft,
                    )}
                  >
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold leading-none">{e.date.slice(8, 10)}</span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] uppercase leading-tight text-muted-foreground">
                      {e.date.slice(5, 7)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{e.title}</p>
                    <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      <Clock className="size-3" aria-hidden /> {e.time} · with{' '}
                      <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-emerald-300">
                        {e.targetUserName}
                      </span>
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <Badge variant="outline" className={cn(eventPill(e.type, 'emerald'), 'border')}>
                    {e.type}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </MotionCard>

      <CreateEventDialog
        open={createOpen}
        onOpenChange={setCreateOpen}
        defaultTargetId={createFor}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * TalentBridge_V2 — job seeker dashboard (BLUE/CYAN identity).
 * Greeting with gradient name + live date, CountUp stat tiles, glass profile
 * card, gradient date-block events, recruiters with gradient Message CTAs.
 */
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { format } from 'date-fns'
import {
  CalendarDays,
  Clock,
  Mail,
  MessageSquare,
  MessageSquareText,
  UserRound,
  Users,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/components/ui/avatar'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { api } from '@/lib/api-client'
import type { SafeUser } from '@/lib/types'
import { useAuthGuard, useAuthErrorEffect } from './auth-context'
import { eventPill, initials, roleTheme, statusBadge, todayISO, toastError } from './tb-utils'
import { CountUp, MotionCard, SectionHeading, StaggerGroup, StaggerItem } from './tb-motion'

interface Props {
  user: SafeUser
  onOpenConversation: (conversationId: string) => void
}

export function SeekerDashboard({ user, onOpenConversation }: Props) {
  const guard = useAuthGuard()
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const theme = roleTheme.blue

  const eventsQuery = useQuery({ queryKey: ['events'], queryFn: api.getEvents })
  const recruitersQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['users', 'recruiter'],
    queryFn: () => api.getUsers('recruiter'),
  })
  const conversationsQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['conversations'],
    queryFn: api.getConversations,
    refetchInterval: 6000,
  })

  useAuthErrorEffect(eventsQuery.error)
  useAuthErrorEffect(recruitersQuery.error)
  useAuthErrorEffect(conversationsQuery.error)

  const openConversation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: api.openConversation,
    onSuccess: ({ conversation }) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['conversations'] })
      onOpenConversation(conversation.id)
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      guard(err)
      toastError(err.message)
    },
  })

  const today = todayISO()
  const upcoming = (eventsQuery.data?.events ?? [])
    .filter((e) => e.date >= today)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.date + a.time).localeCompare(b.date + b.time))
  const unreadDms = (conversationsQuery.data?.conversations ?? []).reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.unreadCount, 0)
  const recruiters = recruitersQuery.data?.users ?? []

  const hour = new Date().getHours()
  const greeting = hour < 12 ? 'Good morning' : hour < 18 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening'
  const firstName = user.name.split(' ')[0]

  const stats = [
    {
      label: 'Upcoming events',
      value: eventsQuery.isLoading ? 0 : upcoming.length,
      icon: CalendarDays,
      hint: 'Interviews & calls ahead',
    },
    {
      label: 'Unread DMs',
      value: conversationsQuery.isLoading ? 0 : unreadDms,
      icon: MessageSquareText,
      hint: 'Waiting for a reply',
    },
    {
      label: 'Recruiters',
      value: recruitersQuery.isLoading ? 0 : recruiters.length,
      icon: Users,
      hint: 'Ready to chat',
    },
  ]

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {/* Greeting */}
      <SectionHeading
        accent="blue"
        eyebrow="Dashboard"
        title={
          <>
            {greeting},{' '}
            <span className={theme.gradientText}>{firstName}</span>
          </>
        }
        description={format(new Date(), 'EEEE, d MMMM yyyy')}
      />

      {/* Stat tiles */}
      <StaggerGroup className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
        {stats.map((s) => (
          <StaggerItem key={s.label}>
            <MotionCard accent="blue" className="flex items-center gap-3.5 p-4">
              <span
                className={cn(
                  'flex size-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-gradient-to-br shadow-lg',
                  theme.gradientSoft,
                  theme.text,
                )}
              >
                <s.icon className="size-5" aria-hidden />
              </span>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                  <CountUp value={s.value} />
                </p>
                <p className="truncate text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{s.label}</p>
              </div>
              <span aria-hidden className={cn('h-1 w-8 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r', theme.gradient, 'opacity-60')} />
            </MotionCard>
          </StaggerItem>
        ))}
      </StaggerGroup>

      <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {/* Profile */}
        <MotionCard accent="blue" className="p-5">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-muted-foreground">My profile</p>
          <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br p-[2.5px]', theme.avatarRing)}>
              <Avatar className="size-14">
                <AvatarFallback className="rounded-full bg-[oklch(0.19_0.022_275)] text-lg font-bold text-white">
                  {initials(user.name)}
                </AvatarFallback>
              </Avatar>
            </span>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <p className="truncate text-base font-semibold tracking-tight">{user.name}</p>
              <p className="truncate text-sm text-muted-foreground">{user.title ?? '—'}</p>
              {user.status && (
                <Badge variant="outline" className={cn('mt-1.5', statusBadge[user.status] ?? '')}>
                  {user.status}
                </Badge>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <Mail className="size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
            <span className="truncate">{user.email}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2">
            <UserRound className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {user.skills.length > 0 ? (
                user.skills.map((skill) => (
                  <span
                    key={skill}
                    className="rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.05] px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-foreground transition-colors duration-200 hover:border-blue-400/40 hover:text-blue-300"
                  >
                    {skill}
                  </span>
                ))
              ) : (
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No skills listed</span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </MotionCard>

        {/* Upcoming events */}
        <MotionCard accent="blue" className="p-5 lg:col-span-2" delay={0.05}>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-muted-foreground">
              Upcoming events
            </p>
            <CalendarDays className={cn('size-4', theme.text)} aria-hidden />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-4">
            {eventsQuery.isLoading ? (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
                  <Skeleton key={i} className="h-16 w-full rounded-lg bg-white/5" />
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : upcoming.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 py-10 text-center">
                <span className="flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-white/8 bg-white/[0.04]">
                  <CalendarDays className="size-4 text-muted-foreground/60" aria-hidden />
                </span>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No events yet</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="max-h-72 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {upcoming.slice(0, 4).map((e) => (
                  <div
                    key={e.id}
                    className="group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-white/[0.06] bg-white/[0.02] p-2.5 transition-all duration-200 hover:translate-x-1 hover:border-white/12 hover:bg-white/[0.05]"
                  >
                    <div
                      className={cn(

                        theme.gradientSoft,
                      )}
                    >
                      <span className="text-sm font-bold leading-none text-foreground">{e.date.slice(8, 10)}</span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] uppercase leading-tight text-muted-foreground">{e.time}</span>
                    </div>

                      <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{e.title}</p>

'use client'

/**
 * TalentBridge_V2 — SPA root.
 * Logo glow-bloom splash → AnimatePresence swap between Login and Shell.
 */
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { useAuth } from './auth-context'
import { AppShell } from './app-shell'
import { LoginPage } from './login-page'

function Splash() {
  return (
    <motion.div
      key="splash"
      className="bg-cosmos fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4"
      initial={{ opacity: 1 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 1.04 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.35, ease: 'easeOut' }}
    >
      <div className="relative">
        <motion.span
          aria-hidden
          className="absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500 to-cyan-400 blur-2xl"
          initial={{ opacity: 0.15, scale: 0.7 }}
          animate={{ opacity: [0.15, 0.75, 0.35], scale: [0.7, 1.25, 1.05] }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.9, ease: 'easeOut' }}
        />
        <motion.span
          className="relative flex size-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500 to-cyan-400 text-xl font-black tracking-tight text-white shadow-2xl"
          initial={{ scale: 0.6, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 260, damping: 18 }}
        >
          TB
        </motion.span>
      </div>
      <motion.p
        className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground"
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ delay: 0.25, duration: 0.35 }}
      >
        Bridging talent to opportunity
      </motion.p>
      <motion.div
        className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground/70"
        initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
        transition={{ delay: 0.4 }}
      >
        <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" aria-hidden />
        Loading TalentBridge_V2…
      </motion.div>
    </motion.div>
  )
}

export function TalentBridgeApp() {
  const { user, loading } = useAuth()
  // Minimum splash time so the glow bloom always plays (~600ms + settle).
  const [minSplash, setMinSplash] = useState(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setMinSplash(false), 850)
    return () => clearTimeout(t)
  }, [])

  return (
    <div className="bg-background min-h-screen">
      <AnimatePresence>{(loading || minSplash) && <Splash key="splash" />}</AnimatePresence>
      <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
        {!user ? (
          <motion.div
            key="login"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -12 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}
          >
            <LoginPage />
          </motion.div>
        ) : (
          <motion.div
            key="shell"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.99 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.35, ease: 'easeOut' }}
          >
            <AppShell user={user} />
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  )
}
